paper.title: Structure-Activity Relationship of Ionizable Lipids for siRNA and mRNA Lipid Nanoparticle Design
paper.title_note: The task brief and several indexes give the last word as 'Delivery'. The PDF title page, the SI title page and the PubMed/Europe PMC record all say 'Design'. Recorded in 08_contradictions.csv.
paper.authors: Sang M. Lee, Yehui Sun, Sumanta Chatterjee, Hu Xiong, Qiang Cheng, Xu Wang, Daniel J. Siegwart
paper.experiment_id_note: First author Sang M. Lee -> SL; issue date 2025. SL_2020 and SL_2021 already exist in the corpus from other first authors; SL_2025 is free. NOT merged - this curation emits only, per the task brief.

licence.state: NOT CC0/CC-BY-compatible as far as we can establish.
licence.evidence: Europe PMC REST record for PMID 40644303 (fetched 2026-11-10) returns isOpenAccess=N, license=null, and the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles endpoint returns errMsg 'Article with id PMC12869450 is not open access one'. The PMC record is an NIH Public Access AUTHOR MANUSCRIPT (NIHMSID NIHMS2133731), which is free to read but carries no CC licence statement. The publisher's version at pubs.acs.org is subscription-only.
licence.consequence: CLAUDE.md section 8 requires every constituent source to be CC0/CC-BY-compatible before corpus release. This paper is not, on the evidence above. Queued as D-7 in DECISIONS.md; not resolved here.
